verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so default DDoS protection and a WAF are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions either. The nearby items (free TLS certificates, a global CDN for static assets, private networking, and a generic 'securing' tagline) are adjacent features and do not show DDoS mitigation or WAF filtering applied to every request.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default
